3.name: Wild Magic Surge
3.notes: After casting a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot, roll 1d20. On a 20, trigger the Wild Magic Surge table. If the result is a spell, it cannot be affected by Metamagic.

3.name: Tides of Chaos
3.notes: Gain Advantage on one D20 Test before rolling. Once used, you must cast a Sorcerer spell with a slot or finish a Long Rest to regain it. Casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot forces an automatic Wild Magic Surge roll.

6.name: Bend Luck
6.notes: After a creature you can see rolls a d20 for a D20 Test, spend 1 Sorcery Point as a Reaction to roll 1d4 and apply it as a bonus or penalty to the roll.

14.name: Controlled Chaos
14.notes: Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can roll twice and choose either result.

18.name: Tamed Surge
18.notes: Immediately after casting a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot, choose any Wild Magic Surge table effect except the final row instead of rolling. If the effect involves a roll, you must make it. Usable once per Long Rest.
